reasoning: This trial appears to have been terminated early due to investigator departure ('PI left institution') rather than completing to assess efficacy. The combination chemotherapy approach targeting BCR-ABL in CML has a reasonable mechanistic rationale - cytotoxic agents should eliminate leukemic cells followed by stem cell rescue for hematopoietic reconstitution. However, no primary endpoint was defined, no results were reported, and there is no evidence of target engagement, biomarker changes, or clinical outcomes. The early termination due to investigator departure suggests this was a commercial/operational decision rather than a scientific failure of the mechanism.
